description: Defines data models and schemas for user and item management, including database models, API schemas, and utility functions for a backend application.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Base schema for user data, including email, active status, superuser status, and full name.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new user, extends UserBase with password field.

classes.name: UserRegister
classes.description: Schema for user registration API, includes email, password, and optional full name.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating user data, all fields optional.

classes.name: UserUpdateMe
classes.description: Schema for updating current user's profile, includes full name and email.

classes.name: UpdatePassword
classes.description: Schema for password update, includes current and new password.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, with UUID primary key, hashed password, creation timestamp, and relationship to items.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Public view schema for user data, includes id and creation timestamp.

classes.name: UsersPublic
classes.description: Schema for a list of public user data and total count.

classes.name: ItemBase
classes.description: Base schema for items, including title and description.

classes.name: ItemUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating an item, with optional title.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Database model for items, with UUID primary key, owner relationship, and timestamps.

classes.name: ItemPublic
classes.description: Public view schema for item data, including id, owner_id, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: ItemsPublic
classes.description: Schema for a list of public item data and total count.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema for access token payload, including token string and type.

classes.name: TokenPayload
classes.description: Schema for JWT token contents, including subject.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Schema for password reset, including token and new password.
